Our Purpose

Our Mission & Vision

We are pioneers in sustainable stationery, transforming banana waste into premium, eco-friendly A4 notebooks that protect trees and promote a circular economy.

Our Vision: To reduce global tree cutting by 25% every year through sustainable, banana-based stationery solutions.

Core Values

Sustainability

Transforming waste into premium products while protecting our planet for future generations.

Community Empowerment

Supporting local communities through ethical practices and fair trade principles.

Quality Craftsmanship

Premium notebooks designed for durability, comfort, and everyday inspiration.

Innovation

Pioneering eco-friendly solutions that redefine what sustainable stationery can be.
